The '''father''' of the [[Kian'thar]] [[Kreet'ah]] and the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Shal'mak]] managed the family's immense [[derlac]] cattle yards on their [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Shaum Hii/Legends|Shaum Hii]].<ref name="SOTE">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

While his wife was ruling a criminal network as a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]], he raised their son, who also worked in his father's trade; until eventually inherited his mother's.<ref name="SOTE" />
